releaseNotes: Redesigned Shopping Lists (Room v6) with structured Name, Quantity + 6-group Unit selector (Weight, Volume, Count, Packaging, Length, Other, plus Custom units), optional standalone Estimated Price, full CRUD, and list-preserving duplicate-safe Convert Basket to Expense.

Added true multi-level Hierarchical Category Trees (arbitrary nesting, Expense & Income separation, streamlined New/Edit Category sheet, recursive CategoriesScreen, Delete Safeguard modal for subtree/usage preservation, and unified HierarchicalCategoryPickerSheet across all flows + analytics drill-down).

Redesigned Android Home Screen Widgets into 4 crisp responsive widgets (4x2 Finance, 4x3 Interactive Shopping List with per-widget list switcher & progress bar, 2x2 Compact Tile, and 4x1 Quick Expense capsule) with Flow Dark / Premium Black / Light theme sync and lock-screen privacy masking.
